purpose: Identify the prospect's primary requirement before qualification.
body: Hi 👋 Welcome to CloudSwift. Tell us what you're looking to solve and we'll point you to the right cloud specialist.

options.label: Cloud Migration / Modernisation
options.description: Move, modernise or transform cloud workloads

options.label: Managed Cloud / Support
options.description: Ongoing cloud operations, monitoring or support

options.label: Cloud Cost / FinOps
options.description: Optimise cloud spend and improve cost visibility

options.label: Security / Compliance
options.description: Cloud security, governance or compliance requirements

options.label: AI / Automation
options.description: Enterprise AI, automation or AI-ready infrastructure

onSubmit: Store requirement and move to A1: Continue / Talk to specialist.
validationNote: The portfolio coverage is supported by CloudSwift materials. The exact number/order of first-screen options should be monitored after launch and simplified if completion data shows friction.
